scripts.title: perfect shot adjustable
scripts.features:
Script Function:
Automatically holds the E key for a set time to perform a perfect shot release

What to Adjust and Why:
You need to adjust the hold time (default: 0.28 seconds).

Timing may vary depending on:
-FPS (frames per second) – low FPS causes input delay
-Network latency or lag
-Device performance

The goal is to find the ideal duration to consistently get green/perfect shots.
